trap-nonspeakable.notes: NOTES (report, not fixed). (1) CONVENTION UNSTATED - and I cannot tell from the block which one applies. The generator volume profile is given as V_i = z a_i + b_i, i.e. it is linear in the Markov parameter z, so its value differs between the excised convention C (z = sqrt(q)/(q+1) = 0.4993203342) and the canonical convention D (z = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.6126880371) - a 23% difference in the z-coefficient at the proton pin. The block names neither, and nothing in it fixes the convention, so this is reported as unresolved rather than as an error. Its sibling sec:garside-gram-intro does name convention D explicitly; if that is the chapter's frame, say so here too. (2) BLOCK KIND: this is kind 'proposition' but carries seven interpretive sections (jet bundle structure, beta and double-beta decay readings, Reeb connection) after the statement. Per clarity-stmt-pure the interpretation belongs in a follow-on remark; the statement itself is the display identity plus the recurrence sentence.
